topic: How to Clean Shower Glass Without Streaks
notes: Use a soft cloth or squeegee and mild detergent as the universal baseline. Do not recommend abrasive pads or harsh cleaners on coated glass or metal frames. Avoid blanket vinegar/acid advice because some shower-door finishes and metal components can be damaged by acids. Tell readers to follow the enclosure manufacturer’s care instructions and to avoid letting cleaners dwell on surfaces unless the product label says so.
